title: $Γ$-convergence for nonlocal phase transitions involving the $H^{1/2}$ norm and surfactants
summary: We study functionals \begin{equation*} F_\varepsilon (u,ρ) := \frac{1}{\varepsilon} \int_ΩW(u) \, dx + \frac{1}{|\ln(\varepsilon)|} \int_Ω\int_Ω \frac{(u(y) - u(x))^2}{|y - x|^{N+1}} \, dy \,dx + \frac{1}{|\ln(\varepsilon)|} \int_Ω\left| \int_Ω \frac{(u(y) - u(x))^2}{|y - x|^{N+1}} \, dy - ρ(x) \right| \,dx \end{equation*} for a double-well potential $W$ and a nonlocal, critically scaled gradient-like term, together with a surfactant term.
